description: This PHP source file defines the AssignClaimRequestController class, which extends AbstractVueController and implements CapableViewController. It manages the assignment of claim requests within the OrangeHRM platform, handling pre-render setup and access control based on user roles and claim request data.

classes.name: AssignClaimRequestController
classes.description: Controller class for assigning claim requests, handling pre-render data setup and access validation.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and UI component for the claim assignment page, retrieves claim request info, and redirects if the user is the employee concerned.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the capability to view or modify the specific claim request, throwing an exception if access should be denied.
